args.title: Fix failure on credit union files with quoted headers
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The issue is that the first line headers are quoted, e.g. "date","amount","description". The parser splits the header line on commas without handling quotes, resulting in headers containing quotes, thus the subsequent row fields do not match the header in count or names.

Propose to update the header parsing to use splitFields() function instead of naive split, so quoted headers are handled consistently with data rows. This should fix the "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" error on credit union files.
